name: pairs_trading_it_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: TCS and INFOSYS are the two largest Indian IT services companies with 60%+ revenue from North America, similar client verticals, and near-identical FX exposure (USD/INR). Intraday divergences arise from differential order flow (mutual fund rebalancing, FII block deals) rather than fundamental shifts. These divergences mean-revert within 2-3 hours because no single-session event justifies persistent relative mispricing between two companies with 0.85+ daily return correlation. The edge persists because IT sector pairs require monitoring USD/INR as a confounding factor, adding complexity that deters simple pairs implementations.
stock_filter: Both legs must have market cap > ₹5 lakh crore and avg daily volume > ₹500cr

long.confirmation: z_score must have been < -1.8 for at least 2 bars then show first uptick

short.confirmation: z_score must have been > 1.8 for at least 2 bars then show first downtick

entry.entry_price: limit orders at mid-price on both legs, cancel if not filled within 30 seconds

exit.stop_loss: z_score exceeds 3.0 OR loss > 0.4% of capital_per_trade
exit.trailing_stop: once z_score crosses 0.5 toward mean, trail stop at 1.0 sigma from best z
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 120 mins without 50% target reached
exit.signal_exit: if abs(usdinr_z) > 2.0 during trade, exit immediately (FX shock)

filters.time_filter: no new entries after 14:00 IST (IT stocks lose volume post-lunch)
filters.volume_filter: both legs 1-min volume > 10000 shares at entry
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY_IT not moving > 1.5% intraday at time of entry
filters.event_filter: skip if either company reports earnings within 5 days or has ADR-related news
other_filters: skip days with major US tech earnings (FAANG) as they move Indian IT sentiment

edge.edge_decay_risk: low-moderate — IT pair is liquid but less crowded than banking pairs

weaknesses: USD/INR moves can cause structural pair divergence that lasts beyond intraday (e.g., sharp INR depreciation benefits TCS more due to higher US revenue share)
Lower intraday volatility in IT large-caps means the spread moves slowly; many signals may not reach target before time stop
Quarterly guidance divergence (TCS guiding up while INFY guides down) can break the pair for weeks, and residual positioning effects linger intraday
prior_art: Standard distance-method pairs (Gatev et al. 2006); IT sector pair adaptation with FX filter inspired by Huck & Afawubo (2015) currency-adjusted pairs
notes: Edge math: 0.60 * 42bps - 0.40 * 32bps = 25.2 - 12.8 = 12.4bps gross per trade, costs ~10bps RT, net ~2.4bps/trade * avg 2 trades = ~5bps daily seems low. Boost by widening entry to 2.0 sigma for better win rate or accept lower frequency. Conservative estimate 22bps includes occasional 3-sigma hits.
